Complete API reference for nprogress-next core.

## Import ```js import NProgress, { createProgress, defaultSettings, injectStyles, version } from 'nprogress-next' import 'nprogress-next/styles.css' // optional ``` ## Singleton: `NProgress` The default export is a ready-to-use singleton, API-compatible with NProgress 0.2.0. ```js import NProgress from 'nprogress-next' NProgress.start() NProgress.set(0.5) NProgress.inc() NProgress.done() ``` ## `createProgress(options?)` Creates an isolated instance. Use when you need multiple independent progress bars. ```js import { createProgress } from 'nprogress-next' const uploadProgress = createProgress({ minimum: 0.1, trickle: false }) const downloadProgress = createProgress({ parent: '#download-area' }) uploadProgress.start() downloadProgress.start() ``` ## Options (`ProgressOptions`) All options are optional. Pass to `createProgress()` or `NProgress.configure()`. | Option | Type | Default | Description | |--------|------|---------|-------------| | `minimum` | number | `0.08` | Minimum progress shown on start | | `easing` | string | `'ease'` | CSS easing for bar transition | | `speed` | number | `200` | Transition duration in ms | | `trickle` | boolean | `true` | Auto-advance while visible | | `trickleRate` | number | `0.02` | Max fraction per trickle step (0.2.0 compat) | | `trickleSpeed` | number | `800` | Interval between trickle steps (ms) | | `showSpinner` | boolean | `true` | Render the corner spinner | | `barSelector` | string | `'[role="bar"], .bar'` | Selector for bar element in template | | `spinnerSelector` | string | `'[role="spinner"], .spinner'` | Selector for spinner element | | `parent` | string \| HTMLElement | `'body'` | Where to mount the bar | | `template` | string | see below | HTML template for the bar | | `id` | string | `'nprogress'` | DOM id for the container | | `ariaLabel` | string \| null | `'Loading'` | Accessible label (`null` to omit) | | `autoInjectStyles` | boolean | `true` | Inject default stylesheet on first render | | `respectReducedMotion` | boolean | `true` | Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` | | `positionUsing` | string | `'translate'` | Positioning method (0.2.0 compat) | ### Default Template ```js const DEFAULT_TEMPLATE = `
` ``` ## Methods | Method | Returns | Description | |--------|---------|-------------| | `start()` | `ProgressInstance` | Show bar at `minimum`, begin trickle loop | | `done(force?)` | `ProgressInstance` | Complete & hide. `force=true` shows even if not started | | `set(n)` | `ProgressInstance` | Set progress `0..1` (clamped to `minimum..1`) | | `inc(amount?)` | `ProgressInstance` | Increment by `amount` or smart default (0.2.0 formula) | | `trickle()` | `ProgressInstance` | Alias for `inc(Math.random() * trickleRate)` | | `configure(opts)` | `ProgressInstance` | Merge options into settings | | `promise(p)` | `ProgressInstance` | Track promise(s); done when all settle | | `render(fromStart?)` | `HTMLElement \| null` | Render container (internal) | | `remove()` | `void` | Remove container & cleanup | | `isStarted()` | `boolean` | Whether progress is active | | `isRendered()` | `boolean` | Whether container is in DOM | | `getPositioningCSS()` | `string` | CSS for bar positioning (0.2.0 compat) | ## Events: `subscribe(listener)` Subscribe to status changes. Returns an unsubscribe function. ```js const unsubscribe = NProgress.subscribe((status) => { console.log('Progress:', status) // number 0..1 or null }) // Later unsubscribe() ``` ## Properties | Property | Type | Description | |----------|------|-------------| | `status` | `number \| null` | Current progress `0..1` or `null` when idle. **Writable** (0.2.0 compat). | | `settings` | `ProgressSettings` | Live settings object. Mutate via `configure()`. | | `version` | `string` | Package version (e.g. `'0.1.0'`) | ## Utilities ```js import { defaultSettings, injectStyles, version } from 'nprogress-next' // Default settings object (clone before mutating) const mySettings = { ...defaultSettings, color: '#f00' } // Manually inject styles (if autoInjectStyles: false) injectStyles() // Version string console.log(version) // '0.1.0' ``` ## SSR Safety All imports and method calls are safe in Node/SSR environments — no `window`/`document` access until `render()` is actually called.

## CDN (Quick Start)

Zero build step — open an HTML file and go.

```html
<!doctype html>
<html>
  <head>
    <meta charset="utf-8" />
    <title>nprogress-next demo</title>
  </head>
  <body>
    <button id="start">Start</button>
    <button id="done">Done</button>

    <script src="https://unpkg.com/nprogress-next@latest"></script>
    <script>
      const startBtn = document.getElementById('start')
      const doneBtn = document.getElementById('done')

      startBtn.addEventListener('click', () => NProgressNext.start())
      doneBtn.addEventListener('click', () => NProgressNext.done())
    </script>
  </body>
</html>
```

## Bundler (ESM)

```js
import NProgress from 'nprogress-next'
// or
import { createProgress } from 'nprogress-next'

NProgress.configure({ color: '#29d' })
NProgress.start()
setTimeout(() => NProgress.done(), 2000)
```

## Isolated Instances

Use `createProgress()` for multiple independent bars.

```js
import { createProgress } from 'nprogress-next'

const upload = createProgress({ parent: '#upload-area', minimum: 0.1 })
const download = createProgress({ parent: '#download-area', trickle: false })

upload.start()
download.start()
```

## Custom Styling

CSS variables (`--np-*`) work with or without the default stylesheet.

```js
// Option 1: Override variables (default stylesheet injected)
NProgress.configure({ autoInjectStyles: true })
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--np-color', '#f00')
document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--np-height', '4px')

// Option 2: Bring your own CSS, disable auto-injection
NProgress.configure({ autoInjectStyles: false })
/* your CSS:
#nprogress .bar { background: var(--np-color, #29d); height: var(--np-height, 2px); }
*/
```

## Full API

Same as [Core API](/core-api) — `NProgressNext` global exposes:

- `start()`, `done()`, `set()`, `inc()`, `trickle()`
- `configure()`, `promise()`, `remove()`
- `isStarted()`, `isRendered()`
- `subscribe(fn)` — reactive updates
- `status` (writable), `settings`, `version`
- `createProgress()`, `defaultSettings`, `injectStyles()`

Drop-in replacement guide from NProgress to nprogress-next.

## Overview **nprogress-next** is a drop-in replacement for **NProgress 0.2.0**. Most apps can migrate by changing the import only. > ✅ **Zero-code migration for most apps** > > ```js > // Before > import NProgress from 'nprogress' > import 'nprogress/nprogress.css' > > // After > import NProgress from 'nprogress-next' > import 'nprogress-next/styles.css' // optional — auto-injected by default > ``` ## API Mapping | NProgress 0.2.0 | nprogress-next | Notes | |-----------------|----------------|-------| | `import NProgress from 'nprogress'` | `import NProgress from 'nprogress-next'` | Same singleton API | | `require('nprogress')` | `require('nprogress-next')` | Returns singleton (CJS interop fixed) | | `NProgress.configure({...})` | Same | All options supported | | `NProgress.start()` | Same | — | | `NProgress.done()` | Same | — | | `NProgress.set(0.5)` | Same | — | | `NProgress.inc()` | Same | Uses 0.2.0 probabilistic formula | | `NProgress.trickle()` | Same | Now `inc(trickleRate)` internally | | `NProgress.promise(p)` | Same | Concurrency semantics identical | | `NProgress.remove()` | Same | — | | `NProgress.status` | Same (now writable) | `NProgress.status = null` works | | `NProgress.settings` | Same (mutable) | Module-level object | | `NProgress.version` | Same | `'0.1.0'` etc. | | `NProgress.getPositioningCSS()` | Same | Returns CSS string | | `import 'nprogress/nprogress.css'` | `import 'nprogress-next/styles.css'` OR auto-injected | CSS variables: `--np-*` | | `new NProgress()` | `import { createProgress } from 'nprogress-next'` | Named export, not constructor | | — | `NProgress.subscribe(fn)` | **New** — reactive updates | | — | `prefers-reduced-motion` respected | **New** — automatic | | — | SSR-safe | **New** — no window access on import | | — | `--np-color`, `--np-height`, `--np-z` | **New** — CSS variable theming | ## Breaking Changes (Minimal) - **Package name:** `nprogress` → `nprogress-next` - **CSS variables:** `--nprogress-*` → `--np-*` (shorter, namespaced) - **CDN global:** `window.NProgress` → `window.NProgressNext` (avoids conflicts) - **Default easing:** `'ease'` (unchanged, but now explicit) - **Default trickleSpeed:** `800` ms (unchanged from 0.2.0) - **Default trickleRate:** `0.02` (restored from 0.2.0) ## Common Patterns ### Ajax Loading ```js // Before (jQuery) $(document).ajaxStart(() => NProgress.start()) $(document).ajaxStop(() => NProgress.done()) // After (fetch + nprogress-next) const originalFetch = window.fetch window.fetch = async (...args) => { NProgress.start() try { return await originalFetch(...args) } finally { NProgress.done() } } ``` ### Router Integration ```tsx // React Router v6 import { useProgress } from 'nprogress-next-react' import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom' export function ProgressWrapper() { const { start, done } = useProgress() const location = useLocation() useEffect(() => { start() const timer = setTimeout(done, 300) // minimum visible time return () => clearTimeout(timer) }, [location.pathname]) return null } ``` ### Custom Template ```js // NProgress 0.2.0 template still works NProgress.configure({ template: '
' }) // nprogress-next also accepts .bar / .spinner classes NProgress.configure({ barSelector: '.bar', spinnerSelector: '.spinner' }) ``` ## TypeScript Types are included — no `@types/nprogress` needed. If you had `declare module 'nprogress'`, update to `'nprogress-next'`.

// After

import 'nprogress-next/styles.css' // optional — auto-injected by default

Breaking Changes (Minimal)

  • Package name: nprogress → nprogress-next
  • CSS variables: --nprogress-* → --np-* (shorter, namespaced)
  • CDN global: window.NProgress → window.NProgressNext (avoids conflicts)
  • Default easing: 'ease' (unchanged, but now explicit)
  • Default trickleSpeed: 800 ms (unchanged from 0.2.0)
  • Default trickleRate: 0.02 (restored from 0.2.0)

Common Patterns

Ajax Loading

// Before (jQuery)
$(document).ajaxStart(() => NProgress.start())
$(document).ajaxStop(() => NProgress.done())

// After (fetch + nprogress-next)
const originalFetch = window.fetch
window.fetch = async (...args) => {
  NProgress.start()
  try {
    return await originalFetch(...args)
  } finally {
    NProgress.done()
  }
}

Router Integration

// React Router v6
import { useProgress } from 'nprogress-next-react'
import { useLocation } from 'react-router-dom'

export function ProgressWrapper() {
  const { start, done } = useProgress()
  const location = useLocation()

  useEffect(() => {
    start()
    const timer = setTimeout(done, 300) // minimum visible time
    return () => clearTimeout(timer)
  }, [location.pathname])

  return null
}

Custom Template

// NProgress 0.2.0 template still works
NProgress.configure({
  template: '<div class="bar"><div class="peg"></div></div><div class="spinner"></div>'
})

// nprogress-next also accepts .bar / .spinner classes
NProgress.configure({
  barSelector: '.bar',
  spinnerSelector: '.spinner'
})

TypeScript

Types are included — no @types/nprogress needed. If you had declare module 'nprogress', update to 'nprogress-next'.

#nprogress {
  pointer-events: none;
}
#nprogress .bar {
  background: var(--np-color, #29d);
  position: fixed;
  z-index: var(--np-z, 1031);
  top: 0; left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: var(--np-height, 2px);
  transform: translate3d(-100%, 0, 0);
  transition: transform var(--np-speed, 200ms) var(--np-easing, ease);
}
#nprogress .peg {
  display: block; position: absolute; right: 0;
  width: var(--np-peg-width, 100px); height: 100%;
  box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--np-color), 0 0 5px var(--np-color);
  opacity: 1; transform: rotate(3deg) translate(0, -4px);
}
#nprogress .spinner {
  display: block; position: fixed; z-index: var(--np-z, 1031);
  top: var(--np-spinner-top, 15px); right: var(--np-spinner-right, 15px);
}
#nprogress .spinner-icon {
  width: var(--np-spinner-size, 18px); height: var(--np-spinner-size, 18px);
  border: 2px solid transparent;
  border-top-color: var(--np-color); border-left-color: var(--np-color);
  border-radius: 50%;
  animation: np-spin 400ms linear infinite;
}
@keyframes np-spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  #nprogress .bar { transition: none; }
  #nprogress .spinner-icon { animation: none; opacity: 0.5; }
}

Reduced Motion Fallback

The default stylesheet includes a prefers-reduced-motion block that stops the spinner and disables transitions. The spinner becomes a dimmed ring (not a broken arc).

## Package Manager

### Core (required for all)

```bash
pnpm add nprogress-next
# or
npm install nprogress-next
# or
yarn add nprogress-next
```

### React Adapter

```bash
pnpm add nprogress-next-react
# peer: react >= 18
```

### Vue Adapter

```bash
pnpm add nprogress-next-vue
# peer: vue ^3.3
```

## CDN (no build step)

Use the UMD global via unpkg or jsDelivr — great for quick prototypes, Astro islands, or legacy apps.

```html
<script src="https://unpkg.com/nprogress-next@latest"></script>
<script>
  NProgressNext.start()
  NProgressNext.done()
</script>
```

The global is `NProgressNext` (not `NProgress`) to avoid conflicts.

## CSS

The core injects its default stylesheet automatically on first render (`autoInjectStyles: true`). To use your own CSS or disable auto-injection:

```js
// Option 1: Import CSS (bundlers)
import 'nprogress-next/styles.css'

// Option 2: Disable auto-injection, use your own
import NProgress from 'nprogress-next'
NProgress.configure({ autoInjectStyles: false })
// ...your custom CSS using --np-* variables...
```

## Framework-Specific Setup

### React (Next.js, Vite, CRA, etc.)

```tsx
import { ProgressBar } from 'nprogress-next-react'
import 'nprogress-next-react/styles.css' // optional, inline styles work without it

export default function RootLayout() {
  return (
    <html>
      <body>
        <ProgressBar color="#29d" />
        {children}
      </body>
    </html>
  )
}
```

### Vue (Nuxt, Vite, etc.)

```ts
import { createApp } from 'vue'
import { NProgressNext } from 'nprogress-next-vue'
import 'nprogress-next-vue/styles.css' // optional

const app = createApp(App)
app.use(NProgressNext) // registers <ProgressBar /> globally
app.mount('#app')
```

### Astro

```astro
---
import { ProgressBar } from 'nprogress-next-react'
---
<html>
  <body>
    <ProgressBar client:load />
    <slot />
  </body>
</html>
```

```js
// Bundler
import NProgress from 'nprogress-next'
NProgress.start()

// CDN
<script src="https://unpkg.com/nprogress-next@latest"></script>
<script> NProgressNext.start() </script>
```

## Built-in Accessibility

nprogress-next follows WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices for `progressbar` pattern.

### What you get automatically

- **`role="progressbar"`** on the container
- **`aria-valuemin="0"`** and **`aria-valuemax="100"`** (0–100 scale)
- **Live `aria-valuenow`** — updates on every progress change
- **`aria-label`** — configurable via `ariaLabel` option (default: "Loading")
- **`aria-busy="true"`** on `<html>` while progress is active
- **Decorative elements hidden:** bar/spinner wrappers have `aria-hidden="true"`

### Reduced Motion

Respects `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` automatically:

- CSS transitions disabled (instant changes)
- Spinner animation stopped
- JS `speed` forced to `0` for instant completion

Disable with `respectReducedMotion: false` in options.

### Keyboard / Screen Reader Testing

```txt
// The progress bar is announced as:
// "Loading, progress bar, 42 percent"
// (or your custom ariaLabel)

// Example with NVDA/JAWS/VoiceOver:
// 1. Trigger NProgress.start()
// 2. Screen reader: "Loading, progress bar, 8 percent"
// 3. As progress updates: "42 percent", "78 percent", "100 percent"
// 4. On done(): "Loading, progress bar, complete" (removed from tree)
```

### Customizing aria-label

```js
// Global singleton
NProgress.configure({ ariaLabel: 'Cargando datos' })

// Or per-instance
const progress = createProgress({ ariaLabel: 'Uploading file' })
progress.start()

// Disable entirely
NProgress.configure({ ariaLabel: null })
```

### Focus Management

The progress bar is **not focusable** (it's a status indicator, not an interactive widget). It lives at the top of the page and does not trap or steal focus.

### Color Contrast

Default `--np-color: #29d` on white meets WCAG AA for non-text contrast (3:1). For custom colors, ensure 3:1 against background.

### Testing Checklist

- ☐ Screen reader announces progress changes
- ☐ `prefers-reduced-motion` stops animations
- ☐ No keyboard focus trap
- ☐ Color contrast ≥ 3:1 (custom colors)
- ☐ `aria-label` is meaningful in your language

## `useProgress(options?)`

Composable that creates a core instance and returns reactive state. Uses `shallowRef` + `watch` + `onScopeDispose` for proper cleanup.

```ts
import { useProgress } from 'nprogress-next-vue'

export default {
  setup() {
    const { progress, status, isStarted, isRendered, start, done, set, inc } = useProgress({
      minimum: 0.1,
      trickle: true
    })

    return { status, start, done }
  }
}
```

| Return | Type | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| `progress` | `ProgressInstance` | Core instance |
| `status` | `Ref<number \| null>` | Reactive progress |
| `isStarted` | `ComputedRef<boolean>` | Reactive started state |
| `isRendered` | `ComputedRef<boolean>` | Reactive rendered state |
| `start()` | `void` | Start progress |
| `done(force?)` | `void` | Complete progress |
| `set(n)` | `void` | Set progress |
| `inc(amount?)` | `void` | Increment |
